svg.title: How a run of apply after a failed one avoids a second comment
svg.desc: Apply looks for the comment of an earlier run of the same event. Without one, it adds the labels and possible-duplicate, posts the comment, and adds needs-info last, so that an issue never waits for an answer to a question that GitHub didn't post. With one, it posts nothing: it adds the labels of the answer and the lifecycle labels that the comment named, except the labels that anyone changed since the comment, and needs-info once the reporter answered.
